ov: Stocky, short-legged omnivores of the weasel and skunk families. The familiar European badger is nocturnal and social, living in family groups in large underground burrows called setts.

why.h: European badgers don’t truly hibernate, but they fatten up in autumn and sleep through much of the winter.
why.ac: It sleeps in its sett by day and is busiest around dusk and dawn.

wt: 7–13 kg in spring, 15–17 kg in autumn (European badger)
df: An omnivore: earthworms, large insects, small mammals, carrion, cereals and tubers.
fx: A sett’s tunnels can run 35–81 m, and several badger families may use one for decades.
